programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores
programme.desc: Un grupo de codiciosos leñadores planea talar el bosque del rey Gerard mientras se encuentra de vacaciones lejos de allí. Papá Pitufo disfraza a los Pitufos de fantasmas para espantar a los leñadores, que se rinden voluntariamente ante el rey cuando este regresa con su séquito.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Choza No Es Un Hogar
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan ocupados demostrando su propia fuerza de voluntad que no se dan cuenta de que Gargamel ha capturado a Pitufo Armonía. Papá Pitufo ofrece a Gargamel una caja con trampa para poner a prueba su fuerza de voluntad, lo que permite escapar a Pitufo Armonía.

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: El Mejor Amigo De Vanidoso
programme.desc: Para Pitufo Vanidoso, no hay ningún espectáculo más fabuloso ni nada más satisfactorio que contemplarse a sí mismo. Cuando se topa con un diablillo adulador, está seguro de que ha encontrado a su mejor amigo para toda la vida. Pero las cosas no siempre son tan sencillas, ya que los amigos pueden meterte en problemas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los días la misma rutina, las mismas tareas, la misma vida… Pitufina está aburrida de todo eso. ¿No sería mucho más divertida una travesía en barco por alta mar? Y resulta que Pitufo Soñador está planeando un crucero. ¿Acaso no suena como el mismísimo paraíso?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se sobrecalienta tras el impacto de un rayo. Papá Pitufo tiene que apresurarse para enfriarlo antes de que se queme. Aun así, Pitufo Robotín utiliza su último voltio de energía para salvar a los Pitufos de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Gorjeos De Smoogle
programme.desc: Clorhidris planea transformar la primavera en la estación más infeliz del año. Atrapa el Azulejo de la Felicidad y lo transforma en un estruendoso cuervo. Cualquiera que oiga el canto del Cuervo de la Infelicidad se volverá infeliz. Solo Gruñón puede salvar la primavera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Busqueda De La Piedra Magica
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: The Evil Dead

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2

programme.title: Special ID

programme.title: Iceman

programme.title: Ghostbusters

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
programme.desc: After a brutal break-up, a young man vows to stay celibate during the forty days of Lent, but finds the girl of his dreams and is unable to do anything about it.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: The unseen side of a great American myth in Priscilla Presley's turbulent relationship with Elvis. Sofia Coppola (The Virgin Suicides) tells a deeply felt and ravishingly detailed portrait of love, fantasy, and fame through her eyes.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager and his gang of fame-obsessed youths use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: Chato's Land

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: The fastest hands in the East meet the biggest mouth in the West when legendary martial arts daredevil Jackie Chan teams with comedic powerhouse Chris Tucker in Rush Hour.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: While vacationing together in Hong Kong, fast-talking LAPD Detective Carter and Hong Kong Police Inspector Lee investigate when a bomb explodes in the American embassy.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Wayne's World

programme.title: Wayne's World 2

programme.title: Citizen Ruth
programme.desc: In this outrageous satire, Laura Dern is Ruth Stoops, an irresponsible, care-free drug addict pregnant for the fifth time, horrifying everyone around her. Soon, Ruth's at the forefront of a national debate, when all she wants to do is party.

programme.title: Serpico

programme.title: Saint Jack

programme.title: Houdini
programme.desc: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
programme.desc: A driven, idealistic defense attorney's life is suddenly disrupted when he is recruited to join a firm led by ambitious lawyer George Pierce and begins a friendship with a young champion for equal rights.

programme.title: IP Man 4: The Finale
programme.desc: Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.

programme.title: Modern Girls
programme.desc: Three young ladies who are looking for love realize that their friendship is more important than romance.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Basic
programme.desc: A former Army Ranger, now working as a DEA agent, is called in to investigate the disappearance of a drill sergeant and several cadets during a training mission that went disastrously wrong in the Panamanian jungle.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Abattoir
programme.desc: A young reporter happens upon a series of gruesome murders tied to real estate mysteries, where entire rooms have been dismantled and pulled from their foundations.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
programme.desc: When their TV is stolen, Beavis and Butt-head hit the road in a hilarious film debut that proves what millions of fans already know: Beavis and Butt-head RULE!

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: Famous detective Hercule Poirot is on the Orient Express, but the train is caught in the snow. When one of the passengers is discovered murdered, Poirot immediately starts investigating.

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: A death-row inmate (Gerard Butler) is caught between the inventor (Michael C. Hall) of a deadly online game and a group that opposes the inventor's high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: On the run from a Detroit crime boss, an ex-con and his adopted brother use a high-tech gun to battle an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their weapon back.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
programme.desc: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: 23rd century: The Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the planet Genesis are empty victories. Spock is dead, and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on an assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails, and Russian troops capture Trautman. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: Transformers

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]

Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We're kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining balance in the wild. They're also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today's culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it's about continuing something that matters.

Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys' premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Kevin Jordan
programme.desc: A Former Los Angeles Police Officer, Kevin has thrilled audiences at Clubs, on Cruise ships, and for the troops worldwide. Kevin is also an Award-winning author, who has opened for John Legend and Gladys Knight.

programme.title: Jeff Jena
programme.desc: Jeffrey Jena is one of the top corporate and cruise comics working today. His thirty-three years of live performance experience and over forty national television shows, both as an actor and comic give him the ability to work for any audience

programme.title: Danny Johnson
programme.desc: Danny Johnson's hilarious, clean stand-up has entertained audiences in comedy clubs, corporate events, and churches nationwide. Often called a cross between Jerry Seinfeld and Kevin James Danny's show is relatable, engaging, and always hilarious. Danny has starred in numerous TV commercials, Comedy Central's Laugh Riots, Florida's Funniest Comedian semi-finalist, Winner-Carnival Cruise line Comedy Challenge, Finalist in Search for the One Christian Comedy contest, and has had the pleasure of sharing the stage with Chris Rock, Bob Saget, Billy Gardell, Richard Lewis, and a variety of others. Danny has led a dual track career for over a decade achieving success in both corporate America and as a comedian. Blending his unique skill sets led to him publishing his first book, "You Stink and They Know It! A practical guide to nailing your next job interview."

programme.title: Brad Stine
programme.desc: Brad Stine is the most media-covered Christian comedian in the country. He had an 8-page profile written about him and his comedy in the New Yorker magazine where he was referred to as Gods Comic.Brad was a regular live social commentator on Fox & Friends every Monday morning for six months.He has been featured in the New York Times, Christian Science Monitor, Los Angeles Times, Wall Street Journal, and USA Today. He has been featured on NBC Nightly News, HBO, Showtime, CNN, Glenn Beck, Hannity and Colmes, NPRS Fresh Air, ABC Nightline, MTV, and Comedy Central. He has had material published in Readers Digest and Focus on the Family magazine.He has five original DVDs featuring his comedy, and has written two books, Live from Middle America Rants from a Red-State Comedian, published by Hudson Street Press and Being a Christian Without Being an IdiotHe has appeared in numerous films including Poodle Springs on HBO, Welcome to Paradise, Sarahs Choice, Christmas With a Capital C, and Covering Your Tracts. He tours nationally on a regular basis performing in clubs, churches, and fundraisers for Crisis pregnancy centers, ministries and conservative causes and candidates.The New Yorker magazine stated that Brads style is frantic, aggressive, and caustic, with echoes of Robin Williams, Sam Kinison, and George Carlin, who is his comedy hero.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Phil Kopczynski

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

programme.desc: The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Sarah Hicks, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir & Tuva Semmingsen
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone's iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono, and Bernard Herrmann. Soloists for this performance are Tuva Semmingsen (mezzo), Christine Nonbo Andersen (soprano), Hans Ulrik (saxophone) and Mads Kjølby (guitars). Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2018.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer
programme.desc: Hans Zimmer is one of the most successful film music composers working today. His multi-award winning career reaches back to the mid-eighties and he has developed close working relationships with renowned directors such as Ridley Scott, Tony Scott, Michael Bay, Ron Howard, Gore Verbinski and Christopher Nolan. His credits include some of the biggest blockbuster movies and most acclaimed TV series of all time. This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr. The staging was spectacular with a ground breaking light show, stunning visuals and a state of the art sound system. With Hans Zimmer performing on multiple instruments and giving introductory insights to many of the pieces, this show is a treat for lovers of both great music and great movies.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood forstrong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching intoclassrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintainingbalance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.desc: "Here at Huckberry, we believe that style isn’t defined solely by what you wear — it’s personified in your morning rituals, your bookshelves and music library, the furniture you choose to spend your waking hours in, and the gear closet that powers your passions and pursuits. Style doesn’t end with your closet, it sparks to life there.On Huckberry Homes, we’ll be tapping into the most inspiring members of the Huckberry community to offer an inside peek into how they’ve crafted the place they call home. We will showcase everything from cold plunges to vinyl listening rooms, home gyms and offices, and other tools that inspire creativity and high-performing lives.For our first entry, we turned to Austin, Texas’ own Scott Ballew. Our good buddy, Scott, is a filmmaker and songwriter who owns a Bohemian bungalow in the heart of Austin’s first suburb. It’s a home now that serves as a creative incubator, gathering place, hideaway, recording studio -- and maybe, as a personal shrine of a man curated by the man himself."

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle explores the Great Lakes on his Sea-Doo in search of walleye and lake trout.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: We will take you to some of the wrecks in the Florida Keys that locals love to dive and share their rich history and the stories held deep aboard these sunken ships. We will also take a deep dive and discuss how these wrecks are critical to the environment.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: Host Ryan McVinney takes Boat Trader fans on an indepth exploration of Florida flats fishing deep in the backcountry of Islamorada. Featuring Captain Eric Lund, a Wall Street Broker turned backcountry fishing guide, this episode reveals the key design features of the world’s best flats skiffs and how they are built for targeting some of the most exciting sportfish species on the planet. Also, covered are bay boats and their versatility for families exploring Florida’s coastal waterways, along with a detailed study of fish species and wildlife in the region. Some of the area’s most beautiful and secret locales show why Islamorada has earned the nickname of the Sportfish Capital of The World.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode of Fox Hollow Outdoors, Michael and Larken end their trip to Florida with an epic day of offshore fishing with Captain Chris Trosset.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: On this episode of Goin' Coastal, Capt. Josh Calhoon brings his store manager Isaiah Lopez with him on a day of inshore fishing for trout and redfish.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: A tough slog of a season for Kenny Hayworth as he bowhunts Saskatchewan.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA Tracker was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: It is Mark Peterson’s third day in Mexico hunting for a Mexican Texanus Whitetail. After bagging two big bucks in just two days with his new Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC, he is now moving to a new farm where a giant 12-point buck has often been seen in the southeast corner of the property. It’s the coldest day since he arrived, which typically means the deer will be more active. He is thrilled at the prospect of what could be the best day yet. If everything goes well, they will spend the evening hunting hogs from the high rack.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he heads to Kentucky for the late muzzleloader season. Already having an unforgettable season so far after taking “Freak Show” back in early September, he is looking to cap off his Kentucky season with a great buck with his Muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. Having already checked off nine species in Argentina, he now finds himself in Peru, where he faces the challenge of tracking down two elusive species to complete his list: the Andean Tinamou and the Western Peruvian Dove.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson continues his journey toward the North America Deer Slam — this time deep in the rugged mountains of North Central Mexico. In pursuit of one of the smallest and rarest Whitetail subspecies, the elusive Mexican Central Plateau Whitetail, Mark faces harsh terrain, high elevations, and the challenge of locating a deer that few hunters have ever seen, let alone taken.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: We are back in Pennsylvania for the start of archery season as Austin continues his 2 year quest for a buck we call Elliot. This buck has been a resident on the farm for at least 3 years now but every archery season he seems to turn into a ghost. After hunting him all of last year with no luck, Austin is hoping that this is the year that it will all finally come together.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to OHIO for some legendary Lake Erie Walleye Fishing. We hook up with Veteran owned businesses “Five-O-Fishing Charters” and “Team Recon Fishing Systems” as they guide us how to fish Lake Erie. We also highlight both of these owners and the service and sacrifice that has led them to where they are today!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure, we travel west to central South Dakota for a Deer hunt of a lifetime!! Military and Law Enforcement Veteran David Huntimer is able to join along as we spot and stalk whitetails and mule deer across the prairie and coulee landscape. Guiding us on the trip is AHO Ambassador John Pikop and Volunteer fire fighter Dustin Aske. We even get a surprise fire call on this outing!! We also highlight our next SCHEELS hometown hero, Mike Hawkins!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Sheila Mitchell-Murphy honors the memory her Son…American hero Etienne Murphy.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: 82 year old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, Patriotic Kenny talks of how he helps other vets through him gifting mobility scooters to fellow veterans in need.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Kasey Morgan of HuntWorX is back in the Show-Me State, self-filming an early season whitetail hunt with one goal in mind, catching up to a mature Missouri 10-point. Banking on a rising moon, predictable feeding patterns, and fresh trail camera intel, Kasey slips into a ridge-top food plot where a giant buck has recently been showing daylight.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This 10 gauge doesn't mess around! Greg Keeton was a well deserved Prostaffer of the Year for WoodHaven. He joins Mark Scroggins and Tony Doty in Nebraska to hunt Merriam's and Rios. Greg has one of the very first Real Hen box calls and guess what, she still sings a pretty turkey tune!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Kansas is known for producing world-class whitetails, and Colten Scroggins of The Fever Crew head to the Sunflower State to hunt with our good friends at Triple H Outfitters. After drawing an early season youth rifle tag, Colten has one goal in mind, tagging a true Kansas giant.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Every great hunting property has a buck that becomes part of its history. In 2017, that buck was "Forky" for Pat Reeve of Driven Hunter. Just days before Minnesota's archery opener, Forky began regularly visiting a strategically placed waterhole, giving Pat the confidence that opening weekend could be something special. With months of preparation leading up to the season, everything came down to being in the right tree at the right time.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Champion caller Scott Ellis is in South Florida Osceola country! They are hunting a small oak head adjacent to an orange grove. The thick cover means you have to be setup perfectly, which is a guessing game and will test your patience. Tons of gobbling and turkey action but Scott has to get sneaky to get this old longbeard to break and come in close.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Three years of patience came down to one perfect evening. Alex Rahman with Prime Ridge Outdoors has watched a buck he calls “Lopsided Larry” for the past three seasons, patiently waiting and giving the deer time to reach his full potential. Heading into 2025, the wait was finally over, and Larry became Alex’s #1 target for the season.

programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: A rich, elderly woman wants her doctor to transplant her brain into the body of one of her young captives.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: Crops thrive on irradiated soil -- so do grasshoppers.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: Mike and the Bots watch 1961s "Bloodlust"; Dr. Forrester's deranged mother comes for a visit.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: A secret agent tries to stop a drug lord from taking over the world with hallucinogenic chewing gum.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: "Devil Doll" (1964) Horror. A ventriloquist puts a girl's soul in a dummy; with Bryant Haliday; William Sylvester; Yvonne Romain.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: "Invasion U.S.A." (1985) Action. An ex-CIA agent protects Florida from terrorists; with Chuck Norris.

programme.desc: The RiffTrax crew roast this 1967 redneck romp with a cardigan-clad Merle Haggard lookalike and a lead who’s not built for sneaking around corners.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: Mike and the bots learn the art of safe driving in the 1959 short, Last Clear Chance. Later, they watch government agents use radar technology to catch criminals in Radar Secret Service (1950).

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
